title: Offline saves and engine checks
description: The IndexedDB save store and the durable feedback queue wired into the offline game: saved games list with Import, the engine-mismatch dialog (view only, try anyway, delete), the storage warning banner, feedback states and the engine label. Every shot is the real app with the real engine in a Web Worker and the real stores; calls to a server are blocked or answered by the capture where a state needs it.

shots.heading: My offline games with several games
shots.caption: Three real games saved in this browser's IndexedDB (4, 3 and 5 players, played a few rounds each). The new Import a game button sits next to the heading. Resume, Export and Delete as before.

shots.caption: The same at 390x844.

notes.title: Reproduce
notes.text: cd web && npm run build:wasm && npm run screenshots -- DP (needs cargo with the wasm32-unknown-unknown target; TI4_WASM_FILE=<file> reuses a prebuilt engine). The captures play real games, so a run takes a few minutes.

notes.title: What is simulated
notes.text: The other-engine save is made by rewriting the stored engine hash; the missing IndexedDB by removing window.indexedDB; the server answers of the feedback states by routes of the capture. Everything else is the production code path.
